title: Recommendations and group decisions
description: Explainable filtering, weighted utility and deterministic group voting.
useCases: Explainable filtering, weighted utility and deterministic group voting.

steps: Read the README and run the local example first.
Preserve module/shared package layout and install the listed dependencies.
Use server adapters only from authenticated bounded handlers; never expose provider keys in browser bundles.

modes.local: Credential-free deterministic code and labeled synthetic fixtures.
modes.live: Same deterministic calculation on caller-supplied real data; no external provider.

verification.local: 7 local tests passed; scoped checkout typecheck, ESLint and credential-free example passed (35 combined experience tests).
verification.exported: Passed 2026-10-09: standalone full recipe npm ci, types, module tests, build and local HTTP run; provider verification is separate.
verification.live: not run — requires operator test credentials and authorization

limitations: At most 2,000 candidates and 100 members; unanimous hard constraints may leave no result.
Similarity requires embeddings from the same model; no provider embedding calls are bundled.
cost: Local computation only; no API charges.
provenance: Original kit implementation and authored synthetic fixtures. Provider docs cited in README; provider terms apply to live data.
